439)smra bsam brjod med spros bral chos kyi sku/ /lhun grub rol ba bde chen longs spyod rdzogs/ /thugs rje 'gro 'dul ḍā ki sprul pa'i ska

tei:div.tei:p: 439)smra bsam brjod med spros bral chos kyi sku// lhun grub rol ba bde chen longs spyod rdzogs// thugs rje 'gro 'dul ḍā ki sprul pa'i sku// bde stong rdo rje phag mor phyag bgyi'o// bdag lus longs spyod dge tshogs rgya mtshor bcas// dang ba'i yid kyis chags zhen bral bar 'bul// thugs rje brtse ba chen pos bzhes nas kyang*// bde stong ye shes mchog gi dngos grub stsol// skye ba du mar zab gter rgya mtsho yi// mdzod la dbang bsgyur rig pa 'dzin rnams kyi/ sbas don rdo rje'i mdud rgya bkrol mdzad pa// 'phags ma tā re dkar mo dran bzhin du// gang sku bde chen pad can phyag rgya'i gzugs// gang gsung brjod bral gnyug ma chos sku'i gsung*// gang thugs rang byung ye shes byang chub sems// 'brel tshad mkha' spyaud zhing du 'khrid mdzad ma// yon tan mi zad nor bu'i dpal mnga' yang*// 'gro ba'i snang ngor dman par zhal gyis bzhes// gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i gtso mor gyur na yang*// glo bur rkyen snang dbang btsan sgyu ma'i lus// nam 'jig cha 440)mi chod ces dgongs bcas gsungs/ rdo rje phag mo arya tā re dkar// ye shes mtsho rgyal man dā ra ba sogs// dbyings bzhugs dhā ki'i tshogs kyis mngon sum par// zhal gzigs lung bstan dbang bskur dbugs dbyung mdzad// bslab dang sbyangs pa'i rim par mi ltos par// dbu ma'i rtsa mdud grol ba'i lag rjes su// snang srid brda dang gdams pa'i mdzod du shar/ khyad par tan gan sbas gsang gnad rnams dang*// ye gsang gnas lugs rig pa'i rang zhal mthong*// las smon ldan rnams smin grol lam la bkod/ khyod kyi yon tan dran bzhin yang yang dad// dug lnga rang gar shor ba bdag 'dra yang*// nyid kyi bde chen ye shes rol rtsal gyis// dbang med sgo gsum rdo rje gsum du sbyor// yengs med 'od gsal chos sku'i rang zhal sprad// bka' drin khyad 'phags 'phags ma yid bzhin nor// chos kyi dbyings la mtshan 'dzin med mod kyang*// gdul bya'i snang ngor ston 'khor tshul du shar// gnas lugs don la dbyer med ro gcig kyang*// ma dag snang ngor tha dad 'khrul mtshams bcad// rig pa'i ngo bor skye 'chi'i 'jigs pa

441)bral// rtag 'dzin snang ngor 'das 'khrungs tshul du snang*// 'khor 'das gnyis la rang dbang bsgyur mod kyang*// bskyed rdzogs rim gnyis don la rtag tu bsgom// gdod nas mngon par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyang*// gdul bya'i blo dang 'tshams par mdzad pa ston// rnal 'byor chen mo bde ba'i rdo rje nyid// bdag cag re ltos 'cha' ba'i rjes 'jug kun// thugs rjes yal bar ma dor rjes su zungs/ g.yo med rdo rje'i khri la brtan bzhugs gsol// 'dab chags gtam gyi tshul du mkha' 'gro'i lung*// the tshom cir yang 'jug pa 'ga' zhig gsungs// yid kyi 'khri shing gzhon nu rgud du bcug /drang don phyi rol yul la brten nas ni// nges don mkha' spyod zhing du 'byon pa'i tshul// zol gyi rnam par yi ge'i lam nas bstan// ma gcig khyed la zhu ba'i tshig 'ga' yod// padma las 'brel rdo rje gzi brjid rtsal// padma gling pa o rgyan bstan gnyis gling*// bsam gtan gling dang 'gro 'dul gling pa sogs// skye phreng du mar bde stong bskyed pa'i grogs// mi dang mi min tshul gyis nam yang mdzad// da lta 442)na rga 'chi ba'i nyon byung tshe// 'chi bdag bdud las rnam par rgyal bar mdzad// nang don byin rlabs ye shes 'bad med par// sbyin mdzad ḍā ki'i rje mo tā re ma// 'khrul pa'i dbang gyur 'gro ba'i log sgrub la// thugs sun ma mdzad 'jam dbyangs spyan gzigs bzhin// thugs bskyed smon lam srid pa gnas kyi bar// gzugs sku nyin byed dbang po brtan bzhugs gsol// gal te zhu yig yal bar dor gyur na/ khyod dang dbyer med lhan du mkha' spyod gling*// dpa' bo bdag kyang 'dun pa gtad nas 'gro// 'di phyi'i re ltos 'cha' sa gcig pu nyid// dgongs pa gzhan du phyogs tshe ji ltar byed// gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i thugs rje mi chung bar// lhan skyes dbang mo'i sku tshe mdzad phrin rgyas// sgab 'dre gdug can rgol ba zil gyis non// rkyen dbang ngan pa'i g.yul las rgyal bar mdzod// thabs shes rten 'brel zab mo'i mthu byin gyis// gcig la gcig brten zab gter sgo 'byed nas// gzhan phan thugs rje'i 'od zer mtha' phas pas// 'brel tshad rig 'dzin zhing du 'dren pa dang*// snod bcud dge mtshan snang ba rab rgyas

443)nas// bstan dang 'gro la phan pa rgya cher shog /'di nas byang chub snying po ma thob bar// bde chen bde ba'i rdo rje mi 'bral zhing*// lhan skyes dga' bzhi'i dpal la spyod pa dang*// gsung gi bdud rtsi'i dbugs dbyung rab thob nas// don gnyis bsam sbyor yid bzhin 'grub gyur cig /gsang spyod lam la the tshom med pa dang*// mdzad spyod thams cad sangs rgyas mdzad par mthong*// mos gus zab mos thugs rgyud byin rlabs bskul// dgongs pa dbyer med gcig tu 'grub par shog /snang ba thabs mchog bde chen he ru ka /stong nyid shes rab rdo rje phag mo yum// zung 'jug sbyor sgrol spyod pa mthar phyin nas/ kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan rdo rje sems// rgyal ba 'od kyi phung por sangs rgyas shog /bdag gi lhag bsam rnam par dag pa yis// bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i dge tshogs rgya mtsho'i rgyun// rgyal yum 'phags ma'i sku tshe brtan phyir 'bul// mgon po tshe mtha' yas pa'i rnam rol du// g.yo med rdo rje'i khri la rtag bzhugs shing*// thugs bzhed 'bad med 'grub pa'i rgyur 'gyur shog e e/ shel bum 444)dri ma med pa// ye shes bdud rtsi'i snod mchog /nyon shes rdul dang bral ba// ma ma'i phyag tu son tshe// dbang bzhi'i chu rgyun 'bebs yong*// dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i nor bu// rgyal mtshan rtse mor byon nas// 'od kyi snang ba 'gyed tshe// mi zad gter du 'byung yong*// rgya gar yul nas byon pa'i// gser bya'i 'dzum mdangs rgyas byed// lha ldan khab kyi khu byug /gshog 'gyur snyan pa'i ngag 'gros// rkang pas bro gar 'khrab bzhin// tsā ri'i thang la phebs tshe// mi sdug ston pa'i khā tas// 'brel med gtam gyi sgro skur// la yog bskul ma byas nas/ khu byug gzhan du bgrod 'dod// brda tshig glu gar ngoms tshe// gnas tshang brag la bcas pa'i// bya rgyal thang dkar rgod pos// sngon gyi bag chags sad nas// cang shes ye shes spyan ldan/

khu byug sngon mo'i drung du// lha gos reg byas drangs pa'i// zhu yig gser gyis phreng ba// smon lam bzang po'i rgyan can// yal 'dab bcu pa'i rtar bskyon// 'gros gnyis ldan par 'phur tshe/ khu byug sngon mos rten 445)'brel// mthu la dgongs nas gsung lan// bde bde mkha' 'gro'i grong khyer// gzhan na med do rang snang*// rlung sems rang dbang thob pa'i/ khu byug sngon mo bdag kyang*// gnas der 'gro 'dod yod kyang*// thang dkar rgod po'i zhu ba// re 'bras don ldan byed gsungs// mi 'gyur g.yung drung khab tu// gser ldan khu byug khyo shug /bde chen dpal la spyod nas// rim gnyis zas bcud mngar mos// bya phran tshogs kyang skyobs nas// 'brel tshad dag pa'i zhing du// 'dren bzhin bzhugs pa a ho// rgod pos gnam 'phang bcad nas// brag ri mthon por chas song*// rigs mthun bsod nams zhing du// dmigs nas gha ṇa'i 'khor los// tshogs gnyis bsags pa mthar phyin// cha shas yo byad dngos pos// mthing mdog dgyes pa skong phyir// skabs skabs sgyu rtsal 'gros kyis// yo byad du mas mchod yong*// dbyings su ro gcig yin mod// kun rdzob snang char rgyun du// sems pa'i cha shas gang nas// lhan du 'tshogs pa a ho// zhes pa 'di yang bya rgyal rgod pos khu 446)byug drung du phul// ༈ lha ldan phyogs nas 'ongs ba'i// g.yu bya khu byug sngon mo// kun rdzob byis pa'i chos la// skyo sun gting nas skyes pas// mi med dben pa'i gnas su// bgrod snyam blo dam bcas kyang*// sngon smon las 'phro'i dbang gis// rten 'brel mthu zab che bas// ne gro rdo rje rdzong nas// rigs ldan ngang pa gzhon nus// las 'brel mthu yis bskul nas// bde stong bcud la longs spyod// sa lam rim par mi ltos// lam dang 'bras bu'i yon tan// gcig car mngon du gyur nas// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa mchog

/thag ring gzhan nas ma rnyed// tan gan dgongs bcud zab mo// myur lam de yi mthu las// rlung sems 'jug pa gcig dril// dbu mgrin rtsa mdud rang grol// chags med chags pa chen pos// chags can ye shes lam bkod// rang byung myur lam bgrod tshul// zur tsam dpe ru bstan na// don dam dbyings ye gnyis med// snang stong thabs shes zung 'jug /bde chen dpa' bo'i rol gar// stong 447)dbyings shes rab btsun mo// phyi nang bya dga' du mas// mnyes par byed pa tshogs lam// gcig tu 'khod cing gnyis kyis// dga' bzhi'i ye shes 'bar nas// bde ba chen po'i rtsa bslangs// dga' mgur spyod pa sbyor lam// zhi ba padma'i dkyil 'khor// 'dab bzhi bam̐ yig mtshan par/ khro bo rtags kyi rdo rje// dkar po hūm̐ yig mthur bstan// mchog gi dngos grub rol phyir// bsrubs sbyor las brtson dang po// rab tu dga' ba'i sa thob// yum gyi rtsa mchog gaṇḍes// dpa' bo'i sems sprin bskul nas// bde chen 'khor lor g.yos pas// dga' ba'i ye shes mthong ste// nyon sgrib rags pa bcom nas// dri ma med pa'i sa thob// sems sprin longs spyod 'khor lor/ khyab spel mchog dga'i ye shes// gsum pa 'od 'phro'i sa thob// nyon sgrib phra ba bcom nas// bzhi pa 'od byed sa thob// sems sprin chos kyi 'khor lor// spel khyab gti mug sgrib dag /lhan dga'i ye shes mngon gyur// rlung lnga ye shes smin 448)pas// lnga pa sbyang dka'i sa thob// sems sprin bdud rtsi zil ma// sprul pa'i 'khor lor khyab pas/ khyad dga'i ye shes mngon gyur// shes sgrib phra ba bcom nas// mngon gyur drug pa'i sa thob// bde stong gnyis su med pa'i// 'od gsal 'khor yug 'byams klas// bdag gzhan dmigs su med pa'i// bdun pa'i sa mchog thob song*// 'dus mdor rlung thig kha sbyor// snang gsum bag chags bcom pas// mi g.yo ba yi sa thob// sems sprin bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun// bde skyong 'khor lor khyab pas// dga' bral ye shes mngon gyur// yon tan yongs rdzogs sa dgu// gzung 'dzin gnyis rtog sangs nas// blo bral gnyug ma'i gshis su// 'khrul snang chos skur sbyor bas// rtsa rlung thig le'i khams rnams// dag rdzogs smin pa sa bcu// bsgom pa'i lam gnad mthar phyin// sems sprin bdud rtsi zhal mjal// skad cig 'od gsal nus pas// sgrib gsum bag chags rab bcom// mi slob lam mchog mthar phyin// kun tu 'od kyi sa thob// rang gsal sgrib med chen po'i// sku

449)dang ye shes yon tan// rtsol sgrub bral ba zung 'jug kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan// bcu gnyis ma chags padma// thim la ma rmugs 'od gsal// bsam brjod phyogs lhung bral ba// sku dang ye shes bdag nyid// ngo bo nyid skur byang chub// bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i// sa lam bgrod pa'i shing rta// bde stong thabs grol chen po// rgyu dang 'bras bu'i sa chod// lam 'bras rim par ma ltos// 'og sgo bde ba chen po/ khams gsum rol pa'i khyad chos// mdor bsdus zur tsam brjod pas// gnas tshang brag la brten pa'i// bya rgyal thang dkar rgod po// rtsal gsum lus la rdzogs tshe// de bzhin thugs la zungs mdzod// bya phran rtsal med rnams la// rlung phyogs tsam yang ma spel// de ltar khu byug sngon mo// sngon smon las 'phro dag pas// rigs ldan ngang pa gzhon nus// thugs brtse thugs rjes bskyang nas// sems sprin bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun// zag med dngos grub stsol ba'i// bde stong ro yis myos nas// gsang 450)spyod gsang ba'i tshig 'di// thang dkar rgod pos bskul phyir// gang shar rang byung gtam 'die// bka' lung gnyis dang mi mthun// rang lam g.yag rwa 'phred rdum// kun bzang bde skyong dbang mos// yig ris bris pa dge'o// ༈ pha gcig rtogs ldan bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis// smin grol gding thob chos sku'i rang zhal mthong*// lta ba klong chen nam mkha'i don rtogs pas// sor bzhag bcos bsgyur gza' gtad kun dang bral// sgom pa sprin bral nyi ma'i 'od ltar gsal// a 'thas gnyis 'dzin 'ching ba'i yul las 'das// snang bzhi stong gsal rgya grol spyod pa mchog /spang blang re dogs 'phrang la nga mi 'jigs// rig pa rang byung ye shes 'pho 'gyur bral// kun bzang gdod ma'i mgon po mngon du gyur// 'bras bu phyi dus mi re rang sa zin// thob bya'i 'bras bu gzhan 'tshol ngas mi bsgrub// de skad mdo med sprang mo'i nyams len lags// bskul ba ma ldog tsam du gus pas phul/

dge'o// 451)a ho/ grub pa'i dbang phyug kun mkhyen chen po// kun bzang dgongs pa rdzogs chen gnas lugs// skye med zang thal nam mkha'i rang bzhin// rang shar rang grol snang ba bden med// snod bcud dag pa'i yul du mi 'dzin// chos nyid rang bzhin bsgom du med pa// gzung 'dzin gnyis su snang ba'i chos can// stong pa'i rang bzhin spros mtha' bral lo// snang stong dbyer med thabs shes zung 'jug /dga' bral bde stong ye shes bcud rol// skye 'gag bral ba'i rig pa mngon gyur// ye gdangs ye shes rtsal snang ma 'gags// sna tshogs snang ba rgyan du shar byung*// mtshams bcad tho brtsegs dgos pa ci yod// byas pa'i chos kyis sangs rgyas mi 'grub// ma byas gu yangs khyab brdal ngang du// 'od gsal don gyis rnal 'byor mdzod cig /de skad sngon smon las 'phro dag pa'i// thabs grogs mkha' 'gro dgyes pa'i rdo rjes// brdzun ris smyo gtam tshul du phul lo/ dge'o// shin tu rab brtse'i dpa' bo mchog gi drung*/ bsod nams dbang mos 452)a mtshar glu ru phul// rig pa'i khye'u chung rig 'dzin rdo rje khyod// smyos pa los bden smyo tshul 'gran zla bral// pho gdon kun tu bzang po'i rgyal pos brlabs// 'khor 'das chos kun ma bcos rig par myos// mo gdon kun tu bzang mo'i 'dre mos brlabs// stong gsal ma 'gags ye shes chen por smyos// rgyal bsen rdo rje 'chang gi gdon gyis brlabs// zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po'i bcud kyis smyos// rang byung lhun grub chen po'i gdon tshogs kyis// sku dang ye shes yon tan mngon gyur brlabs// nang gsal gzhon nu bum sku'i klong du smyos// smyos kyang smyos te chos dbyings ngang du smyos// 'khrul yang 'khrul te chos dbyings ngang du 'khrul// chos kyi dbyings la tshad bzung mi dmigs kyang*// bdag cag 'gro ba'i don du smyo tshul ston/

khyed 'dra'i smyon pa ngo mtshar shin tu che// bdag kyang khyed bzhin smyos na ci ma rung*/ ces pa mdo med 'chol mo ga ga'i ming gis phul// ༈ e ma/ gsang sngags grub pa brnyes pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ gdos bcas mi snang 'od lus mkha' la sbyor/ chags pa'i skyon bral dri med ye shes 453)sku/ khams gsum 'khor ba zag med dbyings su sdud// bde chen bde ba'i 'byung gnas dpa' bo mchog /mi 'gyur kun tu bzang po khyed min nam// chos nyid bden mthong spros pa'i mtha' dang bral// tshe 'dir chos brgyad bya bar sun phyungs te// pha yis gdams pa'i man ngag gsang bcud lon// log lam skyes bu mthu stobs shugs kyis btul// padma'i phrin las mang bdag khyed min nam// shes rab mchog brnyes padma'i thugs bcud dbang*// ye shes sgyu ma'i gar bsgyur 'gro ba'i mgon// dus gsum sangs rgyas rgyal tshab khyed min nam// sku yi rnam 'gyur sangs rgyas mdzad par bstun// gsung gi nga ros gsang sngags sgron me sbar// thugs kyi dgongs pas 'gro kun bu bzhin skyongs// don gnyis dngos grub 'byung gsan khyed min nam// skyon bral yon tan kun rdzogs khyed lta bur/ kho mo bdag 'dras snyed pa e ma ho// skye ba 'di nas tshe rabs thams cad du// yid bzhin nor bu khyed dang mi 'bral bar// dgyes pa bskyed phyir nye rgyu'i gar bsgyur nas// pad 'byung yab yum thugs bzhed yongs 'grub 454)ste// don gnyis lhun grub rta phag mngon gyur cing*// zung 'jug 'bral med 'dun pa'i smon lam zhu zhu zhu/ zhes pa'ang grub brnyes rig 'dzin chen po gter ston rin po che'i sku drung du kun bzang bde skyong dbang mos phyag bcas gus phul// ༈ dus gsum sangs rgyas kun las bka' drin lhag /'di phyi'i re ltos skyabs mgon rin po che// dgongs pa chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*// thugs rje'i 'od zer byams brtses bdag la dgongs// yid bzhin nor bu'i thugs rje'i bka' drin gyis// bdag gis sgrib gnyis shun pa mthar byas nas// ye grol chos sku chen po mngon du mthong*// nyams snang bzang ngan rtog pa ci shar yang*// yang grol sor bzhag mi dgos gnyug mar gnas// re dogs gnyis med 'bras bu rang sa zin// blo bde zhe bde rnal 'byor yin yang bsam// nga ni de ltar ma yin rgyal pos brlabs// mtha' gnyis ma nges snang ba 'ar ma 'ur// rags pa mi snang 'od snang tsam du zad// shes pa chal chol 'di phyi ngos mi zin// snang ba gtad med zang ka yid dpyod bral// bzang rtog re ba'i tshang zhig

555)rtsol ba bral// ngan rtog snying po med pas 'bad pa zhan// bzang ngan gnyis ka 'bad rtsol bya thabs bral// sangs rgyas sems can re dogs rtsa ba zhig /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun ngos yid bzhin nor// mjal ba'i mod la dad dang mos gus ni// mi phyed 'dzin bral chos sku mnyam nyid ngang*// tha dad mi snang rig pa'i ngo bor shar// yum khyim 'khor slob rnams kyang snang tsam las// don la ma nges res snang res mi snang*// lha bsgom sngags bzlas ting 'dzin bsgom pa ni// rol rtsal tsam las re 'bras don ma go/ snang ba thams cad bar ma 'ur/ zang ma zing*/ chal ma chol/ bem rim bral ba 'dra ba 'di ci yin/ gang snang snang tsam/ gang yin yin tsam/ gang min min tsam/ gang shar shar tsam/ gang grol grol tsam/ thams cad gzhi rtsa dang bral ba/ sku gsum gyi bdag nyid las ma 'das pa 'dra yang*/ nges pa med pa 'ar 'ur zang zing*/ khrol khrol 'di rgyal po'i 'phrul yin nam ci yin/ bdag gi bla ma kun mkhyen gsang sngags gling pa khyed mkhyen no/ gegs sel bogs 'don 456)snang ba'i rtsal phyungs shig yang na 'di phyi gang yin ngo sprod cig yang na mi gnas 'pho ba chen po'i sa la drongs shig chal chol gyi gtam/ 'ar 'ur gyi nyams/ ci snang ci shar thams cad zang ma zing*/ thal ma thal 'di mtshar che rmi lam yin nam/ 'di snang yin nam/ bar do yin nam/ ci yin gang yin bla ma mkhyen/ yid bzhin nor bus thugs rjes gzigs/ zhes 'khral 'khrul du smras pas bla ma 'od mthing gi klong na 'dzum mu ler bzhugs pa mthong nas nyams snang las grol song*/ sprul sku yid bzhin nor bus chos dbyings mdzod gsung skabs bde ba'i rdo rjes 'khrul snang yig ris su bris nas phul ba'o// yid bzhin nor bu klong yangs nam mkha' che// 'khor 'das chos kun dbyings kyi rgyan du shar// yid dpyod blo bral dgongs pa nam mkha' 'dra// ma yengs dran 'dzin rtod phur rgod re che/

khyab brdal nam mkha'i 'khor yug 'pho 'gyur bral// mi g.yo chos nyid spros bral dgongs pa rtogs/ rgya chad phyogs lhung bral ba zang ka ma/ 457) /ma yengs dran 'dzin rtod phur rgod re che// chos kun sgyu ma lta bu'i rol rtsal mkhyen// gang snang ye shes rgyan te blang dor bral// ma yengs dran 'dzin gtad so rgod re che// nang gsal rig pa sku dang ye shes dpal// dgongs pa chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*// bdag cag rjes 'jug skal ldan rnams kyi don// thugs klong gsang mdzod zab mo'i chos char 'bebs// snang srid brda dang dpe yi rol par shar// ma yengs dran 'dzin gtad so rgod re che// ka dag spros bral dgongs pa mngon du gyur// rang byung 'od gsal gnyug ma rgyun chad med// 'bad rtsol 'dzin zhen las 'das byang chub sems// blo bral don gyi chos sku mtha' ru phyin// rnam kun mchog ldan dpa' bo chos kyi sku// dran pa yang dag chen pos phyag bgyi'o// bdag cag gzung 'dzin lam gol bdag 'dra yang*// ma rig mun pa'i smag rum las grol phyir// thugs rje'i 'od kyis bdag blo'i mun pa sel// dran snang chos nyid rtogs par thugs rjes zungs// las ngan bdag ni brtse bas 458)rjes bzung nas// gnas ngan 'khor ba'i dbang du mi 'gro zhing*// tshe 'dir yang dag chos la brtson nus shog /bsam pa'i don la bar chad mi 'byung zhing*// dpal mgon bla ma khyed kyi zhabs drung du// 'bral med chos la spyod pa'i smon lam zhu zhu zhu/ ces pa smyon ma 'chol mo 'du shes gsum pas phul/ dge'o// zag bcas nyer len gyi phung po la// a 'thas bden zhen gyi 'ching bas bcings// na tsha zug du yi tshor ba 'di// ma yi bu sangs bzhin myong ba'i dus// zag bcas zag med du 'gro snying 'dod// pha rtogs ldan bla ma'i bka' drin gyis// gzer chen chos sku'i gdams pa yod// gzer 'bring longs sku'i gdams pa yod// gzer chung sprul sku'i gdams pa yod// nga 'chi ba'i gzer la ya mi nga*// 'chi srid chos sku'i rgyal sa red// gzhan na sangs rgyas sa zhig med// dus gsum bde gshegs rten brten pa// rang bzhin gcig gi 'phrul du shar// stong dbyings btsun mo'i mkha' klong du// sgyu ma'i rnal 'byor bzhud na snyam// dpa' bo thabs kyi thugs rten du/

459)/lo cha shas 'di kar gnas lags sam/ khyod mi min yul du mkha' 'gro la// nad zug du'i rim gro ji ltar sgrub// brda sba gsang med par gsung du gsol/ smras pas na re/ yul skyo sun byed pa'i dam grib dang*// byad dug rlangs zur tsam phog pa yin// gnas 'di ru yugs sa'i bang grib phog /mnol bsangs dang ri bsangs lha khrus bya// yul skyo sun thabs kyi mthu yis bzlog /byad dug rlangs na bun sel ba la// dpal nus ldan rdo rje'i go khrab bgo /dus 'bring gsum la khyod la 'tshe ba yod// de rig pas dpyod dang rim gyis gsal/ zer nas/ nga rang gnas 'di'i bdag mo rdo rje kun grags ma yin zer nas 'o chab zhig nga rang la bran nas dadung zhing du ma 'byon ang zer/ ces dus 'dzin chu phag lo'i zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes gcig nyin 'khrul snang la bud med gcig gis khyed ci 'dra mchis zer ba'i lan du sprang mo mdo med dī paṃ tā res smras pa mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan dang rang dbang yod ni lta zhog rmi lam bzang po tsam yang med par btang snyoms su gnas skabs yid 460)bzhin nor bus khyod la nyams snang ci byung yang khog la sbed gsang mi nyan zhes gsung bskul phebs tshe su kha'i ming gis yig ris su bris pa dge'o// ༈ brda dang brda lan dpe don gsum// gter ston rnams kyi spyod pa'i khyad// rten dang 'brel 'byung de las byung*// de phyir brda lan go bar mdzod/ brda zhes pa da lan gyi skabs lta bu la zer/ brda lan zhes pa phyi nang gi rten 'brel la zer/ dpe don zhes pa gzhan gyi mthun rkyen la brten nas don bsgrub pa la zer/ de dag gter ston rnams kyi rten 'brel gyi 'byung khungs lta bu yin pas na stabs gzab dgos zhes smras pa yin/ gter rdzun su kha'i ming gi chos lugs yin// gzhan gyi mthong na bzhad gad gnas su 'gyur/ ha ha/ gang smras chos su mthong ba'i rnal 'byor pa// shī la badzra rtsal gyi dris lan du/

bde chen bde ba'i rdo rjes smras pa'o// nang gsal gyi chos sku de las ma g.yos bzhin du gsal ba'i cha de la longs skur bzhengs nus pa tsam dang*/ de las phyed sprul longs sku/ de las thugs rje sprul skur 461)bzhengs/ de nas 'gro ba gang la gang 'dul gyi ston par snang ba yin/ gdul bya'i sems can ma zad kyi bar du 'dul byed kyi ston pa rgyun mi chad par 'byung ba yin/ snang ba'i chos bdag lus phung po dang bcas pa snang ba'i rgyan/ ye shes kyi rol pa/ ma 'gags pa'i rtsal/ de dag thams cad shar yang rig pa'i ngang las shar/ snang yang rig pa'i ngo bor snang*/ grol yang rig pa'i ngang du grol/ rang gi rig pa de rang snang gi ston pa yin/ rang rig las gzhan pa'i bla ma med do gsungs/ bde ba'i rdo rje'i rmi lam mo/ dus 'dzin lcags khyi lo'i zla ba bdun pa'i nyer lnga'i nub mkha' 'gro'i tshogs gral nas mkha' 'gro kun gsal dbang mos/ he he/ shar tsandan dri la bung ba 'du// lho g.yu khrug ngar skad sa gsum khyab// nub rma bya'i gzi mdangs bag la zha// grogs mtha' yi seng ge'i kha ru tshud/ khyod sngon 'brel gsang grogs dpa' bo ni// bai ro dang dpal gyi dbang phyug zung*// sprul pa klong gsal skye srid sbrul lo pa// gos dkar lcang lo 'dzin pa sa manta// gnas lngar sme ba lha yi spyan 462)'dra yod// rlung bcur dbang thob thabs grol rab la dbang*// 'di dang mi ring myur du 'phrad gyur na// rten 'brel rab la dbang nas gter gnyis kyi// mdzad pa mthar phyin bstan 'gro'i gsos su smin// mtha' dmag dus 'khrugs lnga bcu'i bar du bzlog khyod ni bdun cu lnga nas dpal rir yib// brda don gsang bar sbos la rig pas dpyod// mi 'gyangs myur ru thabs shes zung sbyor dgos// 'gyangs na mkha' 'gro'i dngos grub yal yang srid// mkha' 'gro'i bka' bzhin bsgrub na don gnyis 'grub/
